strategy_descriptions.breathing_chorale: Common long-short phrases and shared breaths; the voices articulate as one body.
strategy_descriptions.antiphonal_choirs: Left and right choirs trade questions and answers, occasionally overlapping at the hinge.
strategy_descriptions.sustained_arch: Long held tones enter in waves, overlap, and withdraw; short gestures appear through the held texture.
strategy_descriptions.reggae_layers: Sparse bass pillars, middle-register offbeat chords, and exposed upper-register responses interlock.
strategy_descriptions.scalar_hocket: Single-note instruments form turning scalar melodies from measured steps of 75–335 cents, favoring half steps, whole steps, and minor thirds.
strategy_descriptions.pillars_and_lace: Slow sustained pillars support sparse, individually exposed phrases.
strategy_descriptions.rhythmic_canon: Four choirs pass the same rhythmic sentence at staggered quarter-note offsets.
strategy_descriptions.diminishing_echoes: A phrase passes through four choirs with progressively quieter answers and longer final sustains.
strategy_descriptions.solo_and_tutti: A few speakers ask expressive questions; the ensemble answers with short punctuation or a long assent.
strategy_descriptions.rotating_cantus: A sustained foreground voice rotates among instruments while the others provide sparse responses.
strategy_descriptions.convergence_fan: A one-time central accumulation: entrances spread into a full choir, unite, then fall away.
strategy_descriptions.triad_lanterns: Exposed sharp-major triads with closely tuned fifths emerge from silence.
strategy_descriptions.consonant_windows: Measured fifths, thirds, and triads are illuminated in contrasting soft instrumental blends.
strategy_descriptions.seventh_responses: Four-note sonorities answer triads, choosing the closest available harmonic or major seventh.
strategy_descriptions.closing_apertures: A one-time coda of exposed duos and diminishing held fragments with clear spaces between them.
strategy_descriptions.arrival_chorale: All 32 pitches arrive together after a shared breath; a sustained chord opens into a softer repeated answer.
strategy_descriptions.harmonic_breaths: Dense sustained choirs take turns inside each harmony, joining at every harmonic arrival.
strategy_descriptions.arrival_waves: Every new chord enters in a close wave; a few quarter-note pulses animate the sustained ensemble.
strategy_descriptions.opening_aperture: The full chord announces each change, then thins to a few voices and exposed lines before its next arrival.

dynamic_envelope.interpolation: linear decibels between section centers, with final fade to -34 dB
